# MuleSoft 308 Interview Q&As & Mock Labs (niranjanpotter.github.io)
> Interactive MuleSoft 4.x / Agentforce / CloudHub 2.0 interview preparation workbench by Niranjan Potter featuring 45 structured curriculum modules (308 scenario-based Q&As), a live browser DataWeave 2.0 Playground, Error Handling Simulator, CloudHub vCore Cost Calculator, Timed Mock Interview mode, and 20 focused technical interview deep-dive guides.

## Core Interactive Interview Workbench
- [MuleSoft 308 Interview Q&A Hub (45 Modules, Mock Interview, DW Playground)](https://niranjanpotter.github.io/): Searchable 308-question technical bank covering DataWeave 2.0, Mule 4.9 LTS / Java 17 internals, Batch Processing, Scatter-Gather, Anypoint MQ, CloudHub 2.0, OAuth 2.0 JWT, Salesforce Bulk API 2.0, SAP S/4HANA, Snowflake, EDI/Partner Manager, MCP Connector, Model Proxy, and Agentforce Topic Center.

## 20 Technical Interview & Architecture Guides
- [MuleSoft Batch Processing Interview Questions & Architecture (2026 Guide)](https://niranjanpotter.github.io/mulesoft-batch-processing-interview-questions.html): Comprehensive MuleSoft Batch Processing interview questions, LMAX Disruptor queue ring buffers, worker crash recovery, and memory sizing for Salesforce Bulk API.
- [CloudHub 1.0 to CloudHub 2.0 Migration Guide: Enterprise 10-Point Checklist](https://niranjanpotter.github.io/cloudhub-1-to-2-migration-guide.html): Step-by-step technical guide for migrating MuleSoft applications from CloudHub 1.0 to CloudHub 2.0 Private Spaces, Ingress routing, and Kubernetes containerization.
- [MuleSoft & Salesforce Agentforce: Topic Center Actions (2026 Guide)](https://niranjanpotter.github.io/mulesoft-agentforce-topic-center-actions.html): How to expose MuleSoft APIs as autonomous Salesforce Agentforce Actions using OpenAPI 3.0 specs, Anypoint Topic Center, and x-sfdc metadata.
- [MuleSoft MCP Connector: Model Context Protocol for Enterprise AI Agents](https://niranjanpotter.github.io/mulesoft-mcp-connector-ai-agents.html): Master the Model Context Protocol (MCP) in MuleSoft. Expose enterprise APIs as MCP tools for Claude, Gemini, and GPT-4 agents.
- [Top 20 MuleSoft Scenario-Based Interview Questions & Incident Solutions](https://niranjanpotter.github.io/mulesoft-scenario-based-interview-questions.html): Real-world MuleSoft scenario interview questions: downstream latency spikes, dual-write failures, worker crashes, and poison pill DLQ debugging.
- [Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 in MuleSoft: Complete Interview & Performance Guide](https://niranjanpotter.github.io/mulesoft-salesforce-bulk-api-2-interview.html): Master Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 with MuleSoft. Handle governor limits, QueryLocator limits, PK chunking, and External ID upserts.
- [MuleSoft Scatter-Gather Router: Interview Questions & Error Recovery](https://niranjanpotter.github.io/mulesoft-scatter-gather-interview-questions.html): In-depth guide to MuleSoft Scatter-Gather router. Master MULE:COMPOSITE_ROUTING errors, payload aggregation, and route isolation.
- [Anypoint MQ & DLQ Architecture: Interview Questions & Best Practices](https://niranjanpotter.github.io/mulesoft-anypoint-mq-dlq-fifo-interview.html): Master Anypoint MQ: FIFO queues, message deduplication IDs, Manual ACK/NACK, Dead Letter Queues (DLQ), and cross-region disaster recovery.
- [DataWeave 2.0 Performance Tuning: Tail Recursion & Memory Optimization](https://niranjanpotter.github.io/dataweave-performance-tuning-patterns.html): Master high-performance DataWeave 2.0: off-heap disk buffering for >100MB payloads, @TailRec recursion, @StreamCapable, and reduce vs groupBy benchmarks.
- [OAuth 2.0 JWT Bearer Token Flow in MuleSoft: Zero-Downtime Key Rotation](https://niranjanpotter.github.io/mulesoft-oauth-jwt-bearer-token-interview.html): Master Salesforce & enterprise OAuth 2.0 JWT Bearer Token flows in MuleSoft. Certificate generation, keystore setup, and zero-downtime key rotation.
- [Anypoint Partner Manager & B2B EDI X12/EDIFACT: Interview Guide](https://niranjanpotter.github.io/mulesoft-partner-manager-b2b-edi-interview.html): Master B2B integrations with Anypoint Partner Manager (APM), AS2 protocols, ANSI X12 (850, 855, 856, 810) parsing, and ESL schemas.
- [MuleSoft Terraform Provider Guide: Infrastructure as Code (IaC)](https://niranjanpotter.github.io/mulesoft-terraform-provider-guide.html): Automate Anypoint Platform with the official MuleSoft Terraform Provider (1.1.0). Provision Private Spaces, API Manager instances, and policies.
- [OpenTelemetry in MuleSoft: Direct Telemetry Export & Distributed Tracing](https://niranjanpotter.github.io/mulesoft-opentelemetry-tracing-observability.html): Master native OpenTelemetry (OTel) in MuleSoft. Stream W3C trace context, spans, and metrics directly to Datadog, Dynatrace, and New Relic without sidecars.
- [MuleSoft Model Proxy: Semantic Caching & LLM Token Cost Optimization](https://niranjanpotter.github.io/mulesoft-model-proxy-semantic-cache.html): How to implement an Anypoint AI Gateway Model Proxy. Semantic caching with vector search, automatic provider fallback, and token quota enforcement.
- [MuleSoft Snowflake Connector: High-Volume Ingestion & Staging Patterns](https://niranjanpotter.github.io/mulesoft-snowflake-connector-patterns.html): Master Snowflake integration with MuleSoft. Compare JDBC row inserts vs Internal Staging, Snowpipe serverless ingestion, and COPY INTO SQL pipelines.
- [MuleSoft CI/CD Pipeline Guide: Maven Plugin & GitHub Actions (2026)](https://niranjanpotter.github.io/mulesoft-cicd-maven-pipeline-guide.html): Enterprise MuleSoft CI/CD automation with the Mule Maven Plugin, SonarQube quality gates, MUnit test coverage thresholds, and automated CloudHub 2.0 deployment.
- [SAP S/4HANA OData vs JCo RFC Connector in MuleSoft: Architecture Guide](https://niranjanpotter.github.io/mulesoft-sap-s4hana-odata-interview.html): Master SAP integration with MuleSoft. Compare modern SAP S/4HANA OData Connector vs legacy JCo RFC/BAPI, bidirectional loop prevention, and high availability.
- [Reusable MuleSoft Global Error Handler Plugin: Enterprise Architecture](https://niranjanpotter.github.io/mulesoft-reusable-error-handler-plugin.html): How to package and distribute an enterprise global error handler as a shared Maven .jar dependency across all development teams using the Mule Java SDK.
- [MuleSoft Secure Properties Tool: AES-256-GCM Encryption Playbook](https://niranjanpotter.github.io/mulesoft-secure-properties-encryption-guide.html): How to encrypt and decrypt sensitive application properties in Mule 4 using the Secure Properties Tool with AES-CBC, AES-GCM, and Blowfish algorithms.
- [Senior Java Mastery for MuleSoft Developers: JVM, Reactive Engine & Concurrency](https://niranjanpotter.github.io/mulesoft-java-interview-mastery.html): Core Java interview questions for senior MuleSoft developers and architects: JVM memory pools, String Constant Pool, Project Reactor, and multi-threading.
